name: reading-note
description: Write research answers as dated reading notes in the ATR house format: answer first, a provenance block, every claim marked established, inferred or speculation, every number with its scale and baseline, no em dashes, and a closing section that says what remains and what needs the operator's decision. Ships the format, the voice rules, a template, a mechanical checker and a page builder that turns the note into a designed, theme-aware HTML page. Skill invokes as reading-note:reading-note.
